items.title: Kimberly-Clark (NASDAQ:KMB) reports Q3 2026 in line with expectations
items.summary: Household products company Kimberly-Clark (NASDAQ:KMB) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, but revenue was flat year on year at $4.13 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.70 per share was 3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
